tools.name: search_lessons
tools.description: Search TheWholeTorah.ai for lessons on a topic, across Mishnah, Tanya, Hayom Yom and Chassidus. Returns titles, links and short excerpts. Use this first to find what exists, then get_lesson for one.

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description: Fetch one lesson by its slug (from search_lessons). Returns the lesson's opening in full and a link to read or listen to the rest on TheWholeTorah.ai.

tools.name: get_source_text
tools.description: Fetch the classical source text a lesson is built on (Mishnah, Shulchan Aruch, Tanya), vocalized, in full. These are public-domain texts via Sefaria.

tools.name: get_daily
tools.description: The Hayom Yom entry for a civil date (default: today in Jerusalem). Hayom Yom is the Rebbe's calendar of daily Chassidus teachings, one short entry per Hebrew calendar day. Note: the Jewish day begins at nightfall, so after dark the next day's entry applies.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: The catalog: every book and collection on TheWholeTorah.ai with its sections and published lesson counts. Use it to see what the library covers before searching.

tools.name: search_sources
tools.description: Hybrid search over the classical text corpora themselves (Mishnah, Talmud, Rashi, Rambam, Shulchan Aruch, Tanya, the commentaries and more), separate from our lessons. Returns labeled passages with links where available. Use search_lessons for our teaching; use this for the primary texts.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Every topic (concept) on TheWholeTorah.ai: bittul, tzimtzum, teshuvah and more, with how many lessons teach it and how many Chassidut In Depth concept cards. Use it to find a topic's slug for get_topic.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: One topic by slug (or an alias such as 'bitul'): its name and description, the Chassidut In Depth concept cards that teach it (each with its link), the closest passages in Sefer HaMaamarim (book, page, a short excerpt), and its most central lessons with links.

tools.name: list_in_depth
tools.description: The maamarim explained word by word in Chassidut In Depth (Sefer HaMaamarim 5659 so far): each with its link, its segments and its concept cards.

tools.name: get_in_depth
tools.description: One Chassidut In Depth maamar (book + maamar slug, from list_in_depth): its parts, its concept cards, and its Lessons and Candy (short essential ideas, each with a link) when it has them. With a concept key, that card: what the term means, what it does in this maamar, and the deeper point. With less

tools.name: get_audio
tools.description: Narration links for a lesson by slug: one MP3 URL per language that has a published recording, so the lesson can be listened to, not just read.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a question and get an answer grounded ONLY in TheWholeTorah.ai's own lessons and sources, with citations. It will say when it does not know rather than guess. Prefer this for 'what does X say about Y' questions.
